svg.title: Tank Valves simulation
svg.desc: Simulation over 300 seconds. Panels show tank 1 and tank 2 water levels in metres. Dashed high and low boundaries on tank 1 control valve switching; tank 2 has a zero-level guide. Mode shading identifies Open, Closed wet, and Closed dry. Eight events visit all three modes. In this run tank 2 empties before each opening, so the declared Closed wet to Open transition is not taken. Empty-level numerical corrections are not depicted as physical jumps.
